title: Na Puchie ke Kya Hussain Hai
body:
Na poochiye k kia Hussain(a.s) hai
Na poochiye k kia Hussain(a.s) hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Quda k dee'n ka naquda,
Har ibteda ke ibteda,
Karam ki inteha Hussain(a.s) hai
Na poochiye ke kya Hussain(a.s) hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Karey jo koi humsaree.. kisi ki kya majaal hai...
Jahan mein har lihaaz se.. Hussain(a.s) bemisaal hai...
Ye ho chuka hai faisla,
Na koi doosra quda ,
No koi doosra Hussain(a.s) hai,
Na poochiye ke kya Hussain(a.s) hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai jis ki fikr Karbala. Hussain(a.s) woh dimagh hai,
Yeh panjetan ki anjuman ka panchawan chiragh hai,
Hasan(a.s) ka pehla hamsafar,
Ali(a.s) ka dusra pisar,
Imam teesra Hussain(a.s) hai,
Na poochiye ke kya Hussain(a.s) hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain(a.s) se jo door hai.. woh sab ghamo se choor hai
Hussain(a.s) ke jo pass hai gham e jaha'n say door hai
Yeh deen jiski den hai
Jo zindagi ka chain hai
Woh sacha qaafiya Hussain(a.s) hai
Na poochiye ke kya Hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaza k baad phir mujhe.. nayi hayat mil gai
Fishaar se azaab se, mujhe najaat mil gai
Sawal jab kia gaya
Hai kon tera rehnuma
Tu mai ne keh dia Hussain(a.s) hai
Na poochiye ke kya Hussain(a.s) hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh jis ne baadh kar hawa.. jala dia bujha dia
Zamee'n ko jis ne arsh se buland martaba dia
Woh jis ne kaaenat ka
Nizam hi badal dia
Ek aisa mojiza husain(a.s) hai
Na poochiye ke kya Hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kisi ko hosla dia.. kisi ko bakhsh di sahar
Dir kisi ko baal o par.. kisi ko de die pisar
Pukari banda parwari
Lughat me ahl e ishq ki
Madad ka tarjuma Hussain hai
Na poochiye ke kya Hussain(a.s) hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Karoge gar muqalifat.. ghame Hussain(a.s) ki yaha'n
Woh hashr hoga hashr me ke al hafeez o al ama'n
Jaha'n bhi chupny jao ge
Kahi'n bhi bach na pao ge
Ke har jagah mera Hussain(a.s) hai
Na poochiye ke kya Hussain(a.s) hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaheed e Karbala ka gham.. jise bhi naagawar hai
Woh bad amal hai bad nasab, usi pe beshumar hai
Are oo dushman e aza
Tu mar zara lehad me ja
Pata chale ga kya Hussain(a.s) hai
Na poochiye ke kya Hussain hai
Bina e la ilaah Hussain hai
